question: Not which field is missing, but which fields are missing TOGETHER. A disease missing one field is a curation backlog; a disease missing four is not under-described, it is undescribed.
population: OMIM-coded diseases in the HPO annotation file. ORPHA- and DECIPHER-coded diseases are excluded: their rows in the same file carry no inheritance annotations and no fractional sign frequencies at all, so for them these fields are unjoinable rather than empty.
caveat: Absence here is absence FROM THESE SOURCES, not absence from the world. A disease with no recorded gene may have a known cause that HPO has not curated; what is counted is the catalogue's silence, which is the only thing a catalogue can be measured on.
